thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from last night's PM — we need to lock owners and timelines for the action items. I drafted assignments below, please claim or shout if you need a different owner.

aj: I'll take RWINF-421 (cache invalidation race) and RWINF-422 (retry backoff tuning). ETA for both: next Wed EOD.

dave: I can own the recurring-pattern analysis (linking similar incidents) — will create an investigation ticket and start a 2 week rolling audit.

olivia: Who's accountable for the rollout of the backoff change? Need an AC for rollout + verification (RACI).

maria: Good Q — propose: AJ = responsible for implementation, Olivia = accountable for rollout verification, SRE = consulted, Product = informed. I'll write a RACI doc and attach.

aj: created jira: RWINF-421, RWINF-422. Command I used: ```jira create RWINF-421 "cache invalidation race" assignee:@aj due:2026-04-08```

incident-bot: Ticket RWINF-421 created by @aj and assigned to @aj. Ticket RWINF-422 created by @aj and assigned to @aj.

dave: For the recurring analysis I'll spin up a short dashboard and tag historical incidents. Plan: weekly sync for 30m, summary in #postmortems each Fri. If someone from infra wants to join, ping me.

olivia: tagging capacity-ops — we should confirm quota bump window for rollout. @capacity-ops, can you confirm if we can get a controlled burst on Thursday?

sre-rotations-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff is Fri 09:00 UTC. If an owner overlaps with handoff, please add a handoff note in the ticket.

maria: Action items summary: RWINF-421 (AJ) due 2026-04-08, RWINF-422 (AJ) due 2026-04-08, Recurring analysis (Dave) kickoff 2026-04-01, RACI doc by me 2026-03-30. Please confirm ownership in-thread by EOD today. Meeting: https://meet.redwood/pm-followup-3 — 30m Tue 14:00 PT.

aj: confirm by EOD. :thumbsup:

dave: confirm, will add handoff checklist to the ticket and coordinate with on-call for runbooks.

maria: Thanks — I'll update the PM with owners and attach the RACI + Jira links. If no objections, I'll proceed to create the follow-up epic and link tickets.

olivia: no objections from me. I'll be standing by for rollout verification window.

aj: quick Q — should we use canary rollout or feature-flagged release? Suggest feature-flag so rollback is trivial.

maria: Feature-flag + canary sounds right. I'll add that to the rollout plan and tag Product.

dave: one more ask: when you create the epic, can you add a label `recurring-patterns` so we can filter?

maria: yep will do. Thanks everyone.
